Class SimulationController

java.lang.Object
controller.SimulationController
public class SimulationController extends Object
The SimulationController class provides functionalities to manage and execute the simulation of train journeys, cargo distribution, yearly progressions, and related operations within a simulation environment. It manages various repositories and ensures accurate handling of scenarios, routes, and industry interactions. Fields: - Simulation constants including resource values (PEOPLE_VALUE, MAIL_VALUE, etc.). - Yearly financial metrics for the simulation (yearlyEarnings, yearlyMaintenanceCost, yearlyFuelCost, etc.). - Lists tracking simulation state such as active journeys, waiting trains, trains preserving cargo, etc. - Current user and various repository references (simulationRepo, mapRepo, industryRepo, etc.). - Demand manager for handling simulations of demands across the environment. Methods: - Public methods include route execution, cargo handling, locomotion maintenance, and simulation resetting. - A wide variety of private helper methods exist for detailed operations such as checking route validity, updating station capacity, managing yearly progression, validating restrictions, and interacting with industries. - Train journey handling includes cargo loading and unloading, calculating arrival earnings, managing route distances, and ensuring proper cargo distribution between entities. - Yearly time progression handles maintenance costs, locomotive updates, and game-end processes. - Data retrieval methods for accessing industries, cities, stations, and user-related details for simulations. Responsibilities: - Execute train routes and manage the entire lifecycle of these journeys based on selected maps and scenarios. - Calculate costs, earnings, and budget implications for each year of the simulation. - Track cargo distributions across stations, industries, and steel mills to manage simulation outcomes. - Monitor and enforce simulation rules related to locomotives, railways, and historical restrictions. - Reset and update simulation parameters to ensure a seamless user experience across runs. Superclass: - java.lang.Object

    • executeRoutes

      public Runnable executeRoutes(Map selectedMap, Scenario selectedScenario, Budget budget, AtomicBoolean running, int currentSimulationYear)
      Executes the routes for the current user in the simulation. This method processes user-defined routes, starts train journeys, and checks arriving trains based on the provided parameters.
      Parameters:
      selectedMap - the map currently selected for the simulation
      selectedScenario - the scenario currently selected for the simulation
      budget - the budget object managing the user's funds
      running - an atomic boolean indicating if the simulation is running
      currentSimulationYear - the current year in the simulation
      Returns:
      a Runnable to execute route-related operations

    • getUserStations

      public List<Station> getUserStations(Map map, Scenario scenario)
      Retrieves a list of stations associated with the current user based on the specified map and scenario.
      Parameters:
      map - the map containing the context for which stations need to be retrieved
      scenario - the scenario context for filtering stations
      Returns:
      a list of stations that match the criteria of belonging to the specified map, scenario, and being owned by the current user. Returns an empty list if the current user is null.

    • passTime

      public Runnable passTime(Scenario selectedScenario, AtomicReference<AtomicIntegerArray> timePeriod, AtomicBoolean running, List<MenuItem> options, ScheduledExecutorService scheduler, AtomicBoolean gameOver, Budget budget, Simulation sim)
      Creates a runnable task that handles the progression of years in the simulation and performs appropriate actions based on the current year and scenario state.
      Parameters:
      selectedScenario - the selected scenario containing relevant simulation data
      timePeriod - an atomic reference to an AtomicIntegerArray holding the current year and the end year
      running - an atomic boolean indicating whether the simulation is running
      options - a list of menu items representing user interaction options
      scheduler - a ScheduledExecutorService for scheduling tasks during the simulation
      gameOver - an atomic boolean indicating whether the simulation has ended
      budget - the budget object related to the simulation
      sim - the simulation instance that handles the core logic of the simulation
      Returns:
      a Runnable that can be executed to manage year progression within the simulation

    • generateCargo

      public void generateCargo(Map selectedMap, Scenario selectedScenario, AtomicReference<AtomicIntegerArray> timePeriod, AtomicBoolean running, ScheduledExecutorService generationScheduler)
      Generates cargo based on the selected map and scenario, and manages the scheduling and execution of the cargo generation process. This method is synchronized with the provided time period and will shut down the scheduler if the time period conditions are no longer met.
      Parameters:
      selectedMap - the map used for cargo generation
      selectedScenario - the scenario used for determining the cargo generation parameters
      timePeriod - a reference to an atomic integer array representing the start and end time of the generation
      running - a flag indicating if cargo generation is currently active
      generationScheduler - the scheduler responsible for managing asynchronous cargo generation tasks
